name: OpenThread Border Router
author: OpenThread
description: OpenThread Border Router (OTBR) connects a Thread mesh network to other IP-based networks such as your LAN and the internet. It is required to bring Thread-based smart-home devices (Matter-over-Thread) onto your network and needs a connected 802.15.4 Radio Co-Processor (RCP) dongle.

form_fields.label: RCP radio device URL
form_fields.hint: Spinel URL of your 802.15.4 RCP dongle. The serial device must exist on the host (see below).

form_fields.label: Serial device path
form_fields.hint: Host path of the RCP dongle, passed through to the container.

form_fields.label: Infrastructure interface
form_fields.hint: Host LAN/Wi-Fi interface, e.g. eth0 or wlan0.
